title: DECIMAL/NUMERIC support in grouped (and scalar) aggregate fan-out
discovery: DECIMAL is f64-backed, serializes to JSON as a STRING. SUM/AVG over DECIMAL return JSON numbers (float); MIN/MAX return JSON strings; COUNT returns ints. So the sum path never sees decimal strings — only MIN/MAX does.

changes.numeric_gate: added is_decimal_type_name to 6 owner-eligibility gates (group_aggregate/group_avg/group_multi_aggregate + scalar avg/avg_distinct/min_max)
changes.extremum: fanout_extremum_value/forward_extremum_value map a finite-decimal JSON string to Value::Decimal (numeric compare) before merge_*_extremum; candidate-acceptance sites accept decimal strings (2 http: GroupAggAcc::update + scalar; 3 pg: single-agg + multi-agg accumulators + scalar)
changes.sum: UNCHANGED — FanoutSum/ForwardSum have no Decimal variant (SUM/AVG return numbers). The initially-added decimal sum path was removed as dead code (extreme simplicity).

safety: TEXT columns still rejected by the gate (461), so no non-decimal string reaches the extremum path; int/float extremum unchanged

verification.pg_decimal_coverage: pgwire decimal path is a line-by-line mirror, covered by the http unit test of the shared logic + the existing pgwire 2-node fan-out integration test + adversarial review

out_of_scope: scalar SUM(DISTINCT) over DECIMAL (distinct-value sum path sees decimal strings; separate follow-up)
